narratives.Overview:
## AppSec remediation

- **Product:** Directive (`deftai/directive`)
- **Finding:** `install-deposit-03`
- **Severity:** high
- **Scan:** 2026-09-21 @ `557873cf26f14fe17a289eea4a297584b4a1432e`
- **Parent:** #4838
- **Report:** [2026-09-21 AppSec report § directive / install-deposit-03](https://github.com/deftai/appsec-scans/blob/8e432e9f247c97c335cedbd82fd18fe76f694fc8/reports/directive/2026-09-21/report.md)

### Impact

`downloadCoreTarball` GETs the GitHub source tarball with no SHA-256 pin. `WriteConsumerGitHooks` then copies payload `.githooks/` to the consumer, chmod 0755, and sets `core.hooksPath=.githooks`, so an unverified archive becomes pre-commit/pre-push as the developer. Distinct from pinned third-party bootstraps (#2908 / #2909) and from the npm `@deftai/directive-content` path.

### Remediation

Pin release tag plus SHA-256 of the source tarball (fail closed before extract), or stop fetching GitHub tarballs and only deposit npm-integrity-backed `@deftai/directive-content`. Do not wire `core.hooksPath` until the payload hash matches.

### Location

- `cmd/deft-install/upgrade.go` (`downloadCoreTarball` / `extractCoreTarball`)
- `cmd/deft-install/githooks.go` (`WriteConsumerGitHooks`)

Do not close until the control is in the default branch (or a later AppSec pass rejects this ID for this sink).



## Derived reason
Prefer-A Bound limbs hand-stamped (#4374). Bound cite 6181295657. YOLO add-to-cohort overrides no-ingest.

items.title: After downloadCoreTarball and before extractCoreTarball, verifyFileSHA256 against Bound pin; on mismatch remove temp and fail closed.
VendorDeft/UpdateDeft/migrate/refresh return trust failure as fatal nonzero before WriteConsumerGitHooks; no hooks from unverified deftDir.
Hard-code pinnedFrameworkTarballTag plus pinnedFrameworkTarballSHA256; refuse non-pinned refs; bind UpdateOutcome identity to pinned verify.
Activation-boundary tests for mismatch and absent pin: nonzero, no extract/deposit/swap, payload and hooks unchanged, temp cleaned.
Reuse verifyFileSHA256 helper; document the fix in CHANGELOG Unreleased Fixed for Tracking 5627; frozen-installer honesty footnote.
